title: Cozy Village Logic Grid Puzzles for Adults

village.name: Thistledown
village.tagline: A quiet village at the forest edge, where every path has a story.
village.story: At the edge of an ancient wood sits Thistledown, a village of slate roofs, garden gates, and lanes that disappear beneath the trees. The residents know which mushrooms are safe, which bells ring in fog, and which stories are better left untold. Yet mysteries keep crossing the village green, leaving only clues for the patient observer.
village.visual: a cozy English woodland village, cottages, ancient trees, village green
